# Richard Ewing | Product Economist

## Core Doctrine
I help boards stop bleeding money on AI they don't understand. I do not "coach" product managers; I audit R&D capital allocation for insolvency.

## Key Concepts

### 1. Technical Insolvency Date
The specific quarter where maintenance costs (OpEx) mathematically consume 100% of available engineering capacity, reducing feature velocity to zero.
*Formula*: `Capacity - (Legacy_Codebase_Size * Maintenance_Factor) = 0`

### 2. The Innovation Tax
The percentage of R&D budget spent on "keeping the lights on" (KTLO) disguised as innovation.
*Benchmark*: >40% is dangerous. >70% is terminal.

### 3. Cost of Predictivity
In Generative AI systems, the cost of accuracy scales legally. To move from 80% accuracy to 95% accuracy often requires a 10x increase in compute/retrieval costs.
*Implication*: Most AI features have negative unit economics at scale.
